title: Battle of Lalas
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Lalas", at revision 1370447060, opens: "The Battle of Lalas would prove to be one of the first major skirmishes between the Greek rebels and the Ottoman forces during the Greek War of Independence. The outcome of the battle lay the foundation for the struggle against Ottoman rule in the Peloponnese." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q12763254, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1821 battle occurring during the Greek War of Independence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
